data.body: **[P2] Put invocation MDC inside the owner-thread scope.** This write occurs before input-deserialization failures are rethrown and before `DurableLogger.attachContext()`/`runHandler` opens cleanup scopes. If deserialization or a later startup factory/hook aborts, `onInvocationEnd` clears the caller thread instead, leaving the pooled handler worker with a stale trace ID. Move the write into `activateHandlerContext` and restore or clear it from the returned same-thread closeable, mirror the fix in `ExecutionOtelPlugin`, and add a reused-worker startup-failure test.
